verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a policy template library written and approved by former auditors, plus a policy editor with attributes and AI-powered revisions. Reminders for personnel to complete policy acceptance imply per-employee acceptance tracking. Nothing in the evidence documents policy versioning or a policy approval workflow, and the only 'date modified' mention is a template attribute, not version history. Missing for 10: policy versioning/history, policy approval workflow, explicit per-employee acceptance tracking dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.
